0022600129.text: The Knicks (0-3, 0-2 at home, on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the East) host the 3-0 Detroit Pistons, who are first in the East and the Central and riding a three-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks were swept 0-3 by Detroit in 2025-26, most recently losing 126-111 in New York on February 19, 2026. New York is without Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain), while Detroit is missing Ausar Thompson (out, ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision.
